name: Intelligence Review of 'Ghost Rocket' Incidents (Scandinavia, 1947)
description: [DOW] Declassified intelligence summary reviewing Scandinavian 'Ghost Rocket' reports from 1946–1947. Document details military investigations into high-speed, fireball-like projectiles displaying non-ballistic trajectories.

name: USAF Memoranda on UAP (Project Sign, 1948)
description: [DOW/USAF] Historical declassified collection of memoranda and administrative correspondence regarding the establishment and initial findings of Project Sign, the Air Force's first formal UAP investigation program.

name: Gulf of Oman 'Cold Orbs' AC-130J Incident Report (2021)
description: [DOW] Intelligence Information Report detailing a UAP encounter involving a Special Operations AC-130J gunship crew. Aircrew observed approximately 25 'cold orbs' hovering near the water, maneuvering aggressively at calculated speeds between 250 and 1,300 mph without visual thermal signature.

name: FD-302: 'Dark Translucent Triangle' Witness Interview (2023)
description: [FBI] FD-302 report detailing a witness account of a large, dark, translucent triangular object hovering silently near Colorado Springs, Colorado. The object appeared to refract light, distorting the stars behind it.

name: Digital Rendering: Dark Translucent Triangle Sighting (2023)
description: [FBI] Reconstructed digital rendering based on witness drawings and telemetry files, illustrating the structure and optical distortion of the translucent UAP reported over Colorado Springs.

name: FD-302: 'Dark Triangle with Lights' Witness Interview (2011)
description: [FBI] Historical witness interview report detailing a massive, silent triangular craft with bright perimeter lights that hovered over suburban Colorado Springs before executing a high-acceleration lateral departure.

name: Digital Rendering: Dark Triangle with Lights Sighting (2011)
description: [FBI] Declassified digital drawing and visual reconstruction of the 2011 triangular object, highlighting the geometry of the craft and location of the white perimeter lights.

name: FD-302: 'Large Triangle with Red Lights' Sighting Report (2023)
description: [FBI] Standard interview record detailing a witness account of an enormous black triangular UAP that emerged from a distorted, 'pixelated' cloud formation over Colorado Springs, moving silently before accelerating at extreme speeds.

name: Digital Rendering: Large Triangle with Red Lights (2023)
description: [FBI] Reconstructed graphic illustrating the large triangular craft as it emerged from the pixelated cloud, showing three red lights on the underside apexes.

name: FD-302: Special Agent Firsthand Sighting Interview (2026)
description: [FBI] FD-302 interview record of a federal Special Agent who observed and thermally recorded multiple unidentified 'black hot' objects moving slowly over a mountain range in the western U.S.

name: Special Agent Black Hawk Scale Reference Memo (2026)
description: [FBI] Internal memorandum reviewing the thermal signature reference data from the Special Agent's recording. Details the inclusion of a U.S. Army Black Hawk helicopter within the same sensor frame to establish physical dimensions and altitude metrics.

name: FD-302: 'Multiple Red Lights' Sighting & Temporal Anomaly (2026)
description: [FBI] Witness interview outlining a cluster of red lights executing synchronized flight paths in the Western US. Account includes details of an anomalous physical effect where the witness's analogue mechanical watch jumped 25 minutes fast during the event.

name: Digital Rendering: Multiple Red Lights (2026)
description: [FBI] Visual reconstruction mapping the multiple red lights reported over the Cascade Mountains, detailing their spherical shape and dynamic orbital patterns.

name: Bahia UAP Incident Diplomatic Cable I (1963)
description: [DOS] Declassified State Department diplomatic telegram detailing an investigation into UAP sightings and magnetic interference events reported over the state of Bahia, Brazil.

name: Bahia UAP Incident Diplomatic Cable II (1963)
description: [DOS] Follow-up diplomatic communication analyzing local radar returns and joint US-Brazilian military security assessments regarding the Bahia objects.

name: NASC Memorandum: 'Space Alien Race Question' (1963)
description: [EOP/NASC] National Aeronautics and Space Council policy memo examining potential social and security implications of confirming non-human intelligence, outlining coordination plans for the White House.

name: CIA Memorandum: Puerto Rico Coast Incident (1965)
description: [CIA] Scientific Intelligence memoranda documenting radar-visual tracking and Navy pilot observations of a submerged/aerial trans-medium craft off the western coast of Puerto Rico.

name: CIA Report: High-Altitude Sphere Encounter (Kabul, 2002)
description: [CIA] Declassified report outlining military personnel reports of a small, reflective sphere traversing restricted airspace at extreme altitude near Kabul, Afghanistan.

name: CIA Intercept Memo: Kabul Spherical Objects (2002)
description: [CIA] Follow-up scientific intelligence memo evaluating electronic monitoring and signals intelligence metrics collected during the Kabul sphere encounters.

name: Holloman AFB Declassified Visual Encounter Report (1964)
description: [DOW] Air Force report summarizing range radar and visual logs recording three disc-shaped objects descending near the Holloman AFB landing strip in April 1964.

name: Kirtland AFB Weapons Storage Area Radar Logs (1980)
description: [DOW] Declassified military police radar files and security logs recording an unidentified contact maneuvering directly over the nuclear weapons storage complex.

name: Malmstrom AFB Missile Flight Shutdown Assessment (1975)
description: [DOW] Internal Strategic Air Command engineering report reviewing systemic control line failures during the November 1975 UAP swarm flyover above Malmstrom AFB missile fields.

name: Special Agent Mountain Range Handheld Thermal Video (2026)
description: [FBI] Declassified infrared video captured by a Special Agent on a handheld thermal imaging sensor, showing 'black hot' slow-moving spherical craft passing near a Black Hawk helicopter.

name: Gulf of Oman AC-130J Infrared Sighting Video I (2021)
description: [DOW] Electro-optical infrared (EO/IR) sensor clip showing multiple cold spherical objects maneuvering dynamically near the sea surface during live-fire gunnery operations.

name: Gulf of Oman AC-130J Flight Telemetry Track (2021)
description: [DOW] Flight deck sensor screen capture illustrating radar overlays and dynamic vector trackings of the cold orbs near the gunship.

name: Gulf of Oman Target Acquisition Cam Frame (2021)
description: [DOW] Mission sensor frame recording a close flyby of a single spherical UAP, showing no tail pipe, wings, or hot exhaust plumes.

name: Gulf of Oman Multi-Sensor Thermal Track (2021)
description: [DOW] Multi-spectral infrared video capturing five cold orbs flying in close, coordinated formation resembling maritime mammal movements.

name: Gulf of Oman Cockpit Audio & Radar Overlay (2021)
description: [DOW] Declassified audio track sync and radar recording illustrating the gunship crew's verbal target descriptions and weapons system lock failures.

name: Gulf of Oman AC-130J Tracking Log Video (2021)
description: [DOW] Target tracking sensor recording illustrating the objects accelerating from a hover to over Mach 2 in a fraction of a second.

name: Navy UAPTF Pacific Sighting Video I (2019)
description: [DOW/USN] Declassified video captured from USS Omaha deck cameras showing a dark spherical object hovering over the Pacific Ocean before descending slowly into the water.

name: Navy UAPTF Pacific Radar Recording (2019)
description: [DOW/USN] CIC radar room screen recording showing multiple target returns swarming a Navy destroyer group off San Diego.

name: Navy UAPTF Pacific Crew Visual Overlay (2019)
description: [DOW/USN] High-resolution optical bridge capture and visual triangulation record of multiple illuminated spheres hovering around Navy vessels.

name: Navy UAPTF Pacific Forward FLIR Record (2019)
description: [DOW/USN] Forward-Looking Infrared sensor clip showing a spherical target flying alongside a Navy vessel at low altitude.

name: Navy UAPTF Pacific Pilot Debriefing Video (2019)
description: [DOW/USN] Recorded debriefing interview of Navy pilots describing the physical characteristics and kinematics of the fast-moving Pacific spheres.

name: CENTCOM Middle East Drone FLIR Video I (2025)
description: [DOW] MQ-9 Reaper drone FLIR sensor clip tracking a spherical, metallic object traversing Middle Eastern airspace at high speed without wings or flight control surfaces.

name: CENTCOM Middle East Ground Radar Track (2025)
description: [DOW] Ground radar array logs recording multiple fast-moving contacts displaying non-ballistic behavior over operational areas.

name: CENTCOM Middle East Mission Sensor Log (2025)
description: [DOW] Tactical data network logs detailing UAP observations and sensor anomalies reported by CENTCOM air assets.

name: CENTCOM Middle East Drone FLIR Video II (2025)
description: [DOW] Follow-up MQ-9 thermal recording tracking a high-velocity spherical object executing sudden vector changes over complex desert terrain.
